tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Near-black tinted green in Night garage, cool off-white in Daylight.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, sheets and the tab bar, sitting on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, pressed rows and nested groups sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between rows. Not for control borders (use `line-strong`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and unchecked controls. 3:1 against `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps and inactive tab labels on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The signature green. Primary buttons, active tab, links, focus ring and DOCUMENTED evidence. Fill with `on-brand` text; as text it needs `bg` or `surface` behind it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: British-racing-green hero fields: the garage header, passport card and onboarding. Pair with `on-brand-deep`.

tokens.name: on-brand-deep
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-deep`, in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-control focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on `bg` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: evidence-estimated
tokens.usage: ESTIMATED evidence level. Always drawn as a dashed outline so it reads as unproven.

tokens.name: evidence-confirmed
tokens.usage: USER_CONFIRMED evidence level. Soft mint, one outline ring.

tokens.name: evidence-documented
tokens.usage: DOCUMENTED evidence level (a confirmed scan). Filled badge with a document glyph.

tokens.name: evidence-verified
tokens.usage: VERIFIED evidence level, the rarest. Champagne, only for third-party-verified entries and the passport seal.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low-confidence OCR fields, expiring passport links. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, revoked passports, destructive confirmations. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmer behind modal sheets.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Large title on the garage and the passport hero. One per screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Replaced engine oil, oil filter and air filter.
styles.usage: Primary reading text; matches iOS Body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mileage 84,200 km at Auto Service Nord.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips and form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and helper text. Never below 12px.

styles.name: vin
styles.usage: VINs, plate numbers, invoice numbers, hashes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tightly related controls; minimum gap between touch targets on Android.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding, list row inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on hero cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above section headings.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of hero fields and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips, inputs inner fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, the passport.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, tab indicator, tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards and sheets over `bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The passport card and the 3D viewer stage.
